name: KENT Automatic Water Softener 100L
summary: The KENT Automatic Water Softener 100L is a fully automatic whole-house water softener featuring 100L food-grade resin , 4,000 LPH flow rate , automatic 5-step regeneration , and an LCD control panel .
intro: The KENT Automatic Water Softener 100L is a high-capacity whole-house water softening system designed for large homes, villas, bungalows, apartments, and commercial establishments. Using an advanced automatic 5-step regeneration process and a highly efficient ion-exchange technology, it removes hardness-causing calcium and magnesium ions from water, delivering soft water throughout your property.
